descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer with strong networking expertise and hands-on experience in designing, implementing, configuring, and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructures.
 Requirements: 
Strong knowledge of networking technologies, protocols, and architectures.
min 5 years of experience as a Network Engineer
Solid experience with Cisco networking equipment and technologies (routers, switches, firewalls).
 Cisco certification is preferred (CCIE is a strong advantage, but other relevant Cisco certifications are also accepted). 
Proven experience in network troubleshooting, performance optimization, and incident resolution.
Ability to work independently and handle complex networking challenges.
 Enterprise-level English communication skills, both written and spoken. 
 Nice to Have: 
Experience working in large-scale enterprise network environments.
 Responsibilities 
Design, implement, configure, and maintain network infrastructure based on Cisco technologies.
Monitor network performance and ensure network availability, stability, and security.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex network issues and incidents.
Manage and optimize routing, switching, and network connectivity.
Perform network upgrades, configurations, and maintenance activities.
Collaborate with infrastructure and IT teams on network-related projects.
Maintain technical documentation and follow network standards and best practices.
 Other info:
full time job (9-18)
remote
Collaboration type: B2B
